name: Code blocks
description: Syntax highlighting in fenced code blocks (```python, ```js, and over a hundred more), each language loaded the first time a block uses it, with Copy and Wrap on each block's first line.

editor.why: Highlight code in notes, and add each block's Copy and Wrap

code-blocks.wrap.description: Wrap long lines in code blocks, as the rest of the note wraps. Wrap on a block changes it for that block while the note is open.
